Human quality inspectors compare each test caption with the reference caption and image, evaluating them across three main dimensions: completeness (whether the test caption omits any details from the image), hallucination (whether the test caption contains incorrect descriptions or fabricated content), and text quality (whether the test caption is grammatically correct, fluent, and free of major expression issues).
